summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc, a UK-incorporated gold miner dual-listed on NYSE/JSE, filed a Form 6-K (the US foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the appointment of Paul Graves as an independent non-executive director effective 1 October 2026. Graves, former CEO of Rio Tinto Lithium and Livent and ex-FMC CFO, joins the Audit and Risk Committee and the Social, Ethics and Sustainability Committee. No transaction, price, stake or shareholder-vote mechanics are involved; the disclosure is a routine governance update with no deal-terms or risk-arb implications.
